channel.title: LP Learning
channel.description: AI explainers, how-tos, tech history and short fiction, made for Luke with Muse.
channel.itunes:author: LPworx

item.title: Build It, Sell It: Cool Things to Make with AI and How They Pay
item.description: Maya and Devon on what you can actually build with AI — fun personal projects, tiny subscription tools, automation services, and digital products — plus the honest math on what each path pays.

item.title: Beyond the Chatbox: Dashboards, Decisions, and the Thousand-Agent Test
item.description: Maya and Devon on AI's shift from prose to verifiable outputs — Claude Dashboards with readable queries, OpenAI's Decisions API returning typed verdicts, and the thousand-agent bug hunt — with practical plays for NetSuite builders and auditors.

item.title: Your Own Private AI: The Local Model Playbook
item.description: Maya and Devon dig into running AI models on your own machine — Ollama, open weights, what fits on real hardware, this week's local AI news, and a privacy-first playbook for sensitive work.

item.title: Meet Muse: What Your Personal AI Agent Can Actually Do
item.description: A special episode all about Muse — Meta's personal AI agent. Maya and Devon tour what it can really do, what people use it for, what it costs, and how to get the most out of it.

item.title: The Pleasant Place
item.description: An original short story in the spirit of Steven L. Peck's A Short Stay in Hell. Tom Ellery wakes in an afterlife that seems... nice. Too nice. Narrated fiction.

item.title: How Computers Work
item.description: Maya and Ben trace the story of computing, from Jacquard's punched-card loom to the phone in your pocket.

item.title: Always-On Agents: Running Your Own Agent Team
item.description: Maya and Devon dig into the week's big shift: always-on coworker agents from Google, OpenAI, and Microsoft, plus the practical playbook for running your own team of agents — job descriptions, planner-executor-reviewer, and specialist tools like REA.
